eyebrow: Learn Fresh · NYC site visit, Maspeth · 12 Oct 2026 · Interview cut
title: Jaelouis C.:
headline: The basketball kid. His first game came down to a last second three, and now math is fun because it is mixed with his favorite sport.
story: Jaelouis plays basketball. His first game that day was close and they won on a last second three with the Caitlin Clark card.
Math used to be “okay”. Now it is “a lot funner” because it is mixed with basketball, and it teaches him player stats and quick math in his head.
Loops: L1 “Did they win?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:07 (“we made the three and we won”). L2 “What does it do for math?” opens at 0:07 and closes at 0:21. Stakes: math that is only “okay”.
do: Open mid-story on “we had a really close game” with the hook text already on screen.
Captions spell the player Caitlin Clark (the auto-transcript writes Kaitlyn).
Cut to the scoreboard and kids playing on “we made the three”.
Put <q>quick math in your head</q> on screen as he says it.
End on “Because I'm playing math hoops”, then the Donate end card.
dont: Do not use the Stephen Curry line about missed shots. It reads as knocking a player, and the Players Association is a partner.
Do not use the school name the student says at the start.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No end-of-year campaign words on the end card.

-14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP peak. Music always under the voice.
Pauses inside a bite longer than 0.7 s are cut to about 0.25 s. Row times in this plan count that.

Two H.264 MP4s: 16:9 1920×1080 and 9:16 1080×1920. Upload to Frame.io, then Ready for Review.
checklist: Frame 1 is the speaker with the hook text already on screen. No logo, no name, no fade at 0:00.
The hook text does not animate on.
The name super comes in at 00:03 or later, lower left, 2 s.
Captions spell NBA Math Hoops, never MBA.
No school names anywhere on screen.
The end card carries the call to action in this plan and nothing about the end-of-year campaign.
Two exports: 16:9 master and 9:16, same edit.
Student super is first name + last initial + grade only. Never a last name.
